hints.title: Even Element Filtering
hints.text: Filter out all odd numbers from consideration and count occurrences of each even number.

hints.title: Frequency Map Accumulation
hints.text: Use a hash map to accumulate frequency counts for each even integer in nums.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Rule
hints.text: Iterate through the frequency entries. Track the element with maximum frequency, breaking ties by choosing the smaller numerical value.

hints.title: Even Frequency Lookup Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass frequency collection followed by single pass max frequency scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated nested counting for each unique element takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map stores counts for even distinct values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Collects frequencies with hash table and handles tie-breaking cleanly.
